_about: What the baked world (low-poly v2) has to manage, and what the tests and the in-game performance overlay (F3 in the real world) measure against. targets: time from opening the world to the car being drivable, a tile's load (fetch or cache, decode, colliders), frame time, draw calls, memory (MB of JS heap; growth over 100 tiles streamed in and out). network: the connection the streaming test assumes (a modest home connection). streaming: the streaming test's run.
